source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 2 - Finishing the Job.md
lexical_plain: The gang survived, they kinda even thrived.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 2 - Finishing the Job.md
lexical_plain: Compared to the rats, the Giant Flaming Spider, the Giant Centipede that crawled out of the well, and the rat that absolutely was NOT about to mutate were no big deal.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 2 - Finishing the Job.md
lexical_plain: After clearing the rest of the wizards tower basement they came away richly rewarded.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 2 - Finishing the Job.md
lexical_plain: Finding a sack of gems, some mystery potions on corpses in the well, and perhaps most importantly bashing down a wall to reveal a room full of healing potions and alchemical tools and ingredients of and ancient and incredible design.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 2 - Finishing the Job.md
lexical_plain: They unfortunately haven't the first clue how to use them, but they are cool!

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 2 - Finishing the Job.md
lexical_plain: Since this room was not part of the original contract, and really neither was the rest of this god forsaken place, they negotiated with Glowkindle for the right to stash gear in the hidden alchemy room.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 2 - Finishing the Job.md
lexical_plain: It's not much but it's a start.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 2 - Finishing the Job.md
lexical_plain: After making pretty good money, 25 gp each, a bit of loot, and learning a lot about the dangers of clearing rats out of basements, the group decided to stick together and see where the winds take them.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 2 - Finishing the Job.md
lexical_plain: Will they ask Glowkindle for more work?

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 2 - Finishing the Job.md
lexical_plain: Will they had back to Stonebridge to say hi to Grishna at the River's Edge Pub?

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 2 - Finishing the Job.md
lexical_plain: Will they follow up on the errant thought of what if there is more to the Wizard's Tower?
